info.title: Spicy3D Server API
info.description: All timestamps are UTC (ISO 8601 with a trailing Z). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details. Authentication: session cookie set by POST /api/auth/login. Unsafe requests (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) must send the header X-Spicy3D-Request: 1, and a browser Origin must match the server's public URL. The read-only document endpoints also accept a personal access token with the documents:read scope (Authorization: Bearer spicy_pat_…, see /api/me/tokens); no other endpoint does.

get.description: Anonymous callers get only the overall `status`; administrators also get `version`, `checkedAt` and `checks`. Results are cached for 10 seconds.

get.summary: Public server configuration for the client: version, feature flags and endpoint URLs.
The admin audit log, newest first (keyset paging with before). Append-only: no endpoint changes it.

post.summary: Save a new head version. Requires If-Match with the current head (409 version_conflict with the head otherwise); upload blobs first (422 blobs_missing). Optional Idempotency-Key header: a retry within 24 hours returns the original version. The recorded parentIds start with the head (If-Match), whatever order they were sent in; to restore an older version, prefer POST /api/versions/{versionId}/restore.

name.description: Label given when it was created.

actorId.description: The administrator (the id stays after that account is deleted).

oneOf.description: Action-specific facts (e.g. `alreadyDisabled`, `expiresAt`); `null` when there are none.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next (older) page; `null` on the last page.

currentPassword.description: The calling administrator's own password, to confirm (403 invalid_password or account_locked otherwise).

disks.description: File systems holding the blobs and the backups (the database disk isn't visible to the API).

emailVerified.description: Whether the email address is verified.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an administrator.

lastSeenAt.description: Last authenticated request (UTC); `null` if never signed in.

disabledAt.description: When the account was disabled (UTC); `null` when enabled.

lockedOutUntil.description: End of a sign-in lockout after failed attempts (UTC); `null` when not locked.

storageUsed.description: Bytes of cloud storage used (unique blobs, uncompressed; counts towards the quota).

keepAllHours.description: Every autosave younger than this is kept.

hourlyDays.description: Up to this age, the last autosave of each UTC hour is kept.

dailyDays.description: Up to this age, the last autosave of each UTC day is kept; older autosaves are deleted.

mergeParentDays.description: An autosave that is a parent of a merge younger than this is kept, whatever its age (0: no such exception).

AutosaveRetentionPolicy.description:
Autosave pruning, relative to now (UTC buckets). Manual, merge, restore, MCP, labeled and pinned versions and the
head are kept forever (the versions `GET /api/documents/{id}/versions?kept=true` lists, plus the head).

configured.description: Whether this server reads a backup status (`Backup:StatusFile`).

lastSuccessAt.description: End of the last successful backup (UTC); `null` when none is recorded.

name.description: That backup's name in the backup target (argument of `deploy/restore.sh`).

sizeBytes.description: Its size: database dump plus blob snapshot.

stale.description: No successful backup within `MaxAgeHours`: show a warning.

maxAgeHours.description: Age after which a backup is stale.

missing.description: The hashes the caller must upload before referencing them.

apiVersion.description: Version of the HTTP contract, an integer bumped on breaking changes.

publicUrl.description: Origin the app is served from, without trailing slash.

eventsSocket.description: WebSocket of real-time events for the signed-in user (SRV-07).

oneOf.description: Remote MCP endpoints; `null` when the MCP feature is disabled.

serverTime.description: Current server time (UTC), lets clients detect clock skew.

email.description: The new email address, from the confirmation link.

name.description: Label, e.g. "Claude Code on my laptop" (1-100 characters).

scopes.description: At least one of mcp:read (MCP read tools and screenshots), mcp:write (MCP editing tools), documents:read (cloud documents and history, read-only).

expiresInDays.description: 30, 90 or 365 days, or 0 for never; omitted: 90.

currentPassword.description: The account's password, to confirm (403 invalid_password or account_locked otherwise).

id.description: Client-chosen id (nanoid): 1–64 characters of `A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -`, unique among the caller's documents.

version.description: The first version (no parents; kind `manual`, `auto` or `mcp`).

token.description: The secret (`spicy_pat_…`). Shown only this once: the server stores only a hash.

items.description: The page, most recently updated first.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

updatedAt.description: Last save, rename, trash or restore (UTC).

name.description: Display name (the server's copy is authoritative for listings).

sizeBytes.description: Size of the latest version (manifest and blobs, uncompressed).

updatedAt.description: Last save, rename, trash or restore (UTC).

deletedAt.description: When moved to the trash (UTC); `null` when not in the trash.

emailVerification.description: A verified email address is required to use cloud storage.

email.description: The server can send email. When `false`, forgot-password and resend-verification answer `email_disabled` (the user should contact the administrator) and email changes apply immediately, unverified.

mcp.description: The remote MCP relay is enabled.

checkedAt.description: When the checks ran (UTC; administrators only).

errors.description: validation_failed only: field errors, from camelCase field names (dotted paths for nested fields, or the header name) to stable error codes.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code; type is urn:spicy3d:problem:{code}.

traceId.description: Identifies the request in the server logs.

headVersionId.description: version_conflict and document_exists only: the document's current head version.

inTrash.description: document_exists only: the existing document is in the trash (restore it, then save a version with If-Match = headVersionId).

headCreatedAt.description: version_conflict only: when the head version was saved.

headDeviceName.description: version_conflict only: the device that saved the head version, if it sent one.

missing.description: blobs_missing only: the SHA-256 of each referenced blob that isn't uploaded, sorted.

endpoint.description: MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint for MCP clients.

pageSocket.description: WebSocket the signed-in Spicy3D tab connects to.

email.description: Email address, also used to sign in.

emailVerified.description: Whether the email address is verified. When the server requires verification, cloud storage is unavailable until it is.

parentIds.description: Parent versions: the current head, plus the client's own parent for a merge (dropped if it no longer exists, e.g. a pruned autosave). Empty for a document's first version. Recorded with the head first, whatever the order sent.

label.description: Optional label (≤ 200 characters); labeled versions are never pruned.

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the manifest blob (uploaded first); at most the server's manifest size limit.

blobs.description: SHA-256 of every blob the manifest references (≤ 10 000). All must be uploaded by the caller or referenced by their versions.

thumbnailSha256.description: Optional thumbnail blob: PNG or WebP, at most 512×512 pixels and 256 KiB.

formatVersion.description: Client document format of the manifest (≥ 1).

deviceName.description: Name of the saving device (≤ 100 characters), shown in the history.

clientId.description: Id of the saving client instance (≤ 100 characters), echoed in real-time events.

resetUrl.description: Link to the web app's reset page; single use.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code; type is urn:spicy3d:problem:{code}.

traceId.description: Identifies the request in the server logs.

headVersionId.description: version_conflict and document_exists only: the document's current head version.

inTrash.description: document_exists only: the existing document is in the trash (restore it, then save a version with If-Match = headVersionId).

headCreatedAt.description: version_conflict only: when the head version was saved.

headDeviceName.description: version_conflict only: the device that saved the head version, if it sent one.

missing.description: blobs_missing only: the SHA-256 of each referenced blob that isn't uploaded, sorted.

email.description: The account's email, to resend without a session; omitted: the signed-in user.

newPassword.description: At least 10 characters, not a common password.

label.description: Optional label of the new restore version (≤ 200 characters).

deviceName.description: Name of the restoring device (≤ 100 characters), shown in the history.

clientId.description: Id of the restoring client instance (≤ 100 characters), echoed in real-time events.

RestoreVersionRequest.description: Optional body of a restore; the content always comes from the restored version.

userAgent.description: User agent of the device that signed in.

ipAddress.description: IP address the session was created from.

expiresAt.description: When the session ends unless used again (UTC).

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

maxManifestBytes.description: Largest manifest a version may reference.

trashRetentionDays.description: Days before documents in the trash are deleted permanently.

autosaveRetention.description: How long autosaves are kept (for the history view).

usedBytes.description: Unique blobs referenced by the user's versions (trash included) or recently uploaded, uncompressed.

displayName.description: New display name; omitted or `null` keeps the current one.

label.description: Optional. A non-empty string sets the label (trimmed, ≤ 200 characters); an empty or whitespace-only string removes it; omitted or `null` keeps the current label.

pinned.description: Optional. `true` pins (never pruned), `false` unpins; omitted or `null` keeps the current value.

UpdateVersionRequest.description:
Partial update: every field is optional and applied independently. An omitted field and an explicit `null`
both mean "keep the current value", so `{}` changes nothing.

updatedAt.description: Last change (UTC); `null` while never saved (all defaults). Ignored in a PUT body.

UserSettingsResponse.description: The settings as returned by GET and PUT: the UserSettings document plus `updatedAt`.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

id.description: Version id (UUIDv7, server clock); versions are ordered by id.

parentIds.description: Parents, in a guaranteed order: none for the first version (or when older autosaves were pruned); otherwise the first is the head the version was saved on (its direct predecessor: for a merge, "theirs", the line merged into), and a merge's second is the merged-from version (the saving device's own line, "merged changes from device"). Pruning autosaves re-parents their children onto their parents, replacing a deleted parent in place, so the order is kept (a merge whose parents collapse onto one version keeps one).

formatVersion.description: Client document format of the manifest. A restore keeps the restored version's format, so the head may go back to an older format; clients migrate on load.

manifestSha256.description: Manifest blob; the content is served by `GET /api/versions/{versionId}`.

sizeBytes.description: Manifest plus referenced blobs, uncompressed, each counted once.

accessToken.description: Personal access token (POST /api/me/tokens). Accepted only where an operation lists it, with the scopes it names, and by the MCP endpoint /mcp.
